data.name: Warrior Duels
data.detailed_description:
Warrior Duels is an immersive online trading card game that pits two legendary warriors from distinct historical factions against each other in a duel of skill, strength, and strategy.  Choose from preconstructed decks or build your own, play against opponents from around the world, or challenge the AI.

Warrior Duels is completely free with built-in tutorials to teach the game mechanics.  Simple to learn, challenging to master!

  • Choose from 13 different warriors, each with unique abilities

  • Build custom decks with powerful attacks, defenses, and tactical cards

  • Outmaneuver your opponent with skillful card combinations

  • Make attacks concealed, unblockable, or undodgeable to avoid defenses

  • Used tactical cards that favor your faction's skills

  • Weapon and Armor cards for even more strategies

  • Counter cards that can be used as Attacks or Blocks

Eleven different factions offer unique gameplay each having different strengths.  Barbarians are attack focused with little regard for defenses.  The Ninja relies on concealment and sneak attacks, the Samurai uses lightning quick attacks and defenses.

  • Current factions include: Barbarian, Knight, Legionnaire, Ninja, Samurai, Sword Master, Amazon, Mongol, Inca, Carthaginian and Viking

  • Addition factions coming in future sets!

  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 8600 GT or ATI™ Radeon™ HD 2600XT or better

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ 2 Duo (2.2 GHz) or AMD® Athlon™ 64 X2 (2.6 GHz) or better
